name: Katsuragi Kazuhisa
source:
A second-year student who transferred from another school in Osaka to Yaesaka High. Possessing a bright and spirited personality, one wonders why he likes Kanako, whose character is the exact opposite of his. 

Edited from [url=http://alicesoft.wikia.com/wiki/Atlach-Nacha]AliceSoftWikia[/url]
